name: bb-shared
description: Share bb threads with guests via scoped, revocable tokens. Monorepo root — npm workspaces for the plugin + vendored tunnel packages.

scripts.build: npm --prefix worker run build && bb plugin build plugin
scripts.test: npm exec --workspace=bb-plugin-shared -- vitest run && npm --prefix worker test
scripts.typecheck: npm exec --workspace=bb-plugin-shared -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix worker run typecheck
